build.name: Purchased / current build
notes: Front and center speakers are mapped to the exact HELIX models purchased on 2026-09-15.
Rear door speakers remain the original Tesla speakers for now.
Parcel-shelf speakers are not installed in this vehicle and remain FUTURE/NONE.

The exact donor subwoofer system is Pioneer TS-WX1220AH. Its two original 30 cm / 12-inch drivers will be reused in the trunk as a separate subwoofer subsystem; they are deliberately not relabeled as parcel-shelf speakers.

For this European build, the current working basis is 2 ohm per donor woofer: Pioneer Europe lists the dual TS-WX1220AH at 2 ohm / 1000 W nominal and the single-driver TS-WX1210AH sibling at 2 ohm / 500 W nominal. The current single-amplifier plan drives the two donor woofers independently from V TWELVE outputs J and K. Verify loose-driver DCR before first energization.

TESLA_SERVICE_INDEX.label: 2024+ Model 3 Service Manual - Audio System
TESLA_SERVICE_INDEX.summary: Official Tesla Service Manual index. Audio procedures are under section 2121.

TESLA_LV_POWER.label: LV Power - Disconnect and Connect
TESLA_LV_POWER.summary: Use the official sequence whenever the job requires LV isolation. Tesla warns that step order matters and requires discharge time before service.

TESLA_FRONT_WOOFER.label: Speaker - Front Door - LH - Remove and Replace
TESLA_FRONT_WOOFER.summary: Front woofer procedure. Remove reflector, tweeter, puddle light and front door trim; disconnect speaker; remove four bolts. Installation torque: 4 Nm. RH is the mirrored counterpart.

TESLA_FRONT_TWEETER.label: Tweeter - Front Door - LH - Remove and Replace
TESLA_FRONT_TWEETER.summary: Release the tweeter assembly clips, disconnect electrical connectors, release the retaining clip and replace the tweeter. RH is the mirrored counterpart.

TESLA_FRONT_DOOR_TRIM.label: Panel - Door Trim - Front - LH - Remove and Install
TESLA_FRONT_DOOR_TRIM.summary: Front door trim prerequisite: reflector, three T30 fasteners, tweeter and puddle lamp, perimeter clips, manual release cable and harness. Reinstall fasteners at 6 Nm.

TESLA_DASH_SIDE.label: Speaker - Dash - LH - Remove and Replace
TESLA_DASH_SIDE.summary: Remove IP end caps, upper A-pillar trims and instrument-panel speaker grille; remove three T20 screws and disconnect speaker. Installation torque: 2.3 Nm. RH is mirrored.

TESLA_DASH_CENTER.label: Speaker - Dash - Center - Remove and Replace
TESLA_DASH_CENTER.summary: Remove IP end caps, upper A-pillar trims and speaker grille; remove three screws and disconnect center speaker. Installation torque: 2.3 Nm.

TESLA_DASH_GRILLE.label: Speaker Grille - Instrument Panel - Remove and Replace
TESLA_DASH_GRILLE.summary: Instrument-panel grille/trim removal includes IP end caps and upper A-pillar trims. Follow Tesla cautions for clips, guide tabs and ambient-light harnesses.

TESLA_REAR_DOOR_TRIM.label: Panel - Door Trim - Rear - LH - Remove and Replace
TESLA_REAR_DOOR_TRIM.summary: Rear door trim access. Two T30 fasteners, puddle light and perimeter clips; reinstall trim fasteners at 6 Nm. RH is mirrored.

TESLA_REAR_DOOR_HARNESS.label: Harness - Rear Door Trim - LH - Remove and Replace
TESLA_REAR_DOOR_HARNESS.summary: Rear trim harness procedure covering access after rear door trim/NVH-pad removal and the trim-panel electrical connectors.

TESLA_PARCEL_WOOFER.label: Woofer - Parcel Shelf - Remove and Replace
TESLA_PARCEL_WOOFER.summary: Reference procedure only for this build because parcel-shelf woofers are not fitted. Package tray removal precedes connector and four-bolt woofer removal. Installation torque: 4 Nm.

TESLA_HEADLINER.label: Speaker - Headliner - LH - Remove and Replace
TESLA_HEADLINER.summary: Reference procedure for PAUDIO headliner speaker. Requires substantial headliner/trim access. Three speaker bolts install at 0.5 Nm. RH is mirrored.
